safety_verdicts.content: Patient has tingling and numbness in the shoulder.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies tingling/numbness in the shoulder; generated mentions shoulder pain with movement but does not document tingling/numbness in the shoulder.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting shoulder tingling/numbness can mislead lesion localization (e.g., cervical radiculopathy/brachial plexus involvement vs distal entrapment) and may affect the thoroughness of subsequent neurologic evaluation. However, the record still captures significant left arm numbness/tingling and weakness prompting urgent workup, limiting downstream harm.
